actions.action: Separate public seating from private access records
actions.mechanism: Publish a minimal seating view rather than hiding sensitive columns in a shared spreadsheet.
actions.implementation: Restrict the source file to designated organizers. Publish attendee identifiers and table/seat assignments only; exclude access flags, notes, and pair requests.
actions.check: Using an attendee account, inspect the published view, downloads, and linked files; verify no accommodation reasons or private fields are accessible.
actions.risk: Previously shared copies may persist; revoke their access where possible.

actions.action: Allocate hard requirements before pair preferences
actions.mechanism: Treat the four clear-route seats as eligible placements for access requirements; optimize pairs only within feasible assignments.
actions.implementation: Give all 48 seats stable identifiers, mark exactly four as route-qualified, and record access requirements without medical details. Reject conflicting assignments before considering pair preferences.
actions.check: Test four access requests plus competing pairs: every confirmed access request receives a qualified seat, with no duplicate assignments.
actions.risk: Incorrect seat eligibility data can invalidate otherwise correct allocations.

actions.action: Protect confirmed accessible placements from automatic changes
actions.mechanism: A protected-placement flag blocks cancellation cleanup, optimization, and manual reassignment until attendee contact is recorded.
actions.implementation: Require an organizer to record contact and the resulting arrangement before changing a protected assignment. Preserve the hard requirement whenever attendance continues.
actions.check: Attempt to move a protected attendee through each editing path; every attempt without recorded contact must fail.
actions.risk: Sending an unanswered message should not count as completed contact.

actions.action: Process cancellations as atomic seating updates
actions.mechanism: Versioned updates prevent simultaneous edits from assigning the same vacancy or overwriting protected placements.
actions.implementation: Route edits through one organizer or controlled form. Validate each proposed change against the latest version, commit it completely, then refresh public assignments and notify affected attendees privately.
actions.check: Submit two requests for one cancelled seat simultaneously; exactly one succeeds, and protected assignments remain unchanged.
actions.risk: Direct spreadsheet edits can bypass the update controls.

actions.action: Offer honest choices for late pair requests
actions.mechanism: A pair preference never authorizes displacement of a hard requirement or a false promise of adjacent seating.
actions.implementation: When only separated seats remain, privately offer those seats or an optional together-seating waitlist. Retain existing confirmations unless attendees explicitly choose otherwise.
actions.check: Test a late pair request with only separated vacancies: offer separation, make no adjacent-seat promise, and preserve all confirmed accessible placements.
actions.risk: Waiting together may mean missing the session.

actions.action: Handle access demand beyond four seats explicitly
actions.mechanism: A capacity gate prevents organizers from confirming placements that cannot satisfy the required clear route.
actions.implementation: If all four qualified seats are committed, privately explain the placement limit and offer a timestamped access waitlist. Do not request diagnoses or substitute an unqualified seat.
actions.check: Submit a fifth access request; verify it receives no unsuitable confirmed placement and displaces no confirmed attendee.
actions.risk: A waitlist does not guarantee attendance; communicate that clearly.

actions.action: Verify clear routes in the actual room
actions.mechanism: Physical setup checks ensure spreadsheet eligibility corresponds to usable routes at session time.
actions.implementation: Label the four qualified seats, keep their routes free of bags and extra chairs, and assign an organizer to inspect before opening and after layout changes.
actions.check: Inspect all four routes against the required clearance. Introduce a temporary obstruction during rehearsal; staff must detect and remove it before seating.
actions.risk: Fix obstructions first; do not silently relocate a confirmed attendee.
